d:
Jharkhand Vidhansabha men RJD vidhayak Suresh Paswan ne SIR par bola hamla, kaha ye | Ranchi
Jharkhand vidhanasbha men SIR (Special Intensive Revision) ke mudde par vidhaykon ka virodh lagatar jari hai. isi bich vidhayak suresh pasvan ne SIR ko lekar jamkar hamla bola. unhonne sadan men apni bat rakhte hue kya kuchh kaha aur SIR par kya saval uthae? dekhie suresh pasvan ka pura bayana.
